title: Per-launch lineup and budget overrides on run.plan and run.start
lead: The daemon takes an optional lineup and budgets for one run, checks them, shows them in the plan and writes them to run.json. The matrix stays the default. No TUI in this slice.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The owner wants to set each slice's roles to another vendor, model or effort than the role matrix gives, for one launch. Decision 24 (lineup.source, decided): the lineup comes from `slicer relay-roles recommend`, the chain is the primary row plus its alternatives, and it is "editable at launch". docs/design.md:147-150 says "The owner can edit both". The glossary (docs/glossary.md:63-66) says the owner accepts the lineup as a whole or overrides rows. Decision 46 (run.budgets, decided) and docs/design.md:529-533 give per-slice budgets "with defaults in the registry and overrides at launch".

slicer has no per-run override: `slicer relay-roles` changes the stored matrix only (`slicer relay-roles --help`; `slicer --root ../slicer find "lineup override"` finds nothing). So the per-run override is ork's.

Today the plan takes the first Claude row per role and drops the rest (internal/daemon/runs.go:225-253). The engine already takes a lineup per run (internal/engine/engine.go:95-101) and copies it into run.json (:179-192). Budgets come only from the registry (engine.go:191).

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/daemon/runs.go`: RunParams (:40-46) gains optional Lineup and Budgets (record 134, `run.launch-wire`, decided 2026-10-20: the full lineup per role plus budgets). RunPlan (:55-64) gains Budgets so the plan shows them and the Expected check (:275-281) covers them. planRun (:208-269) applies and checks the override after the recommend loop (:225-253). startRun (:270-316) passes Budgets in engine.Config (:304).
- `internal/engine/engine.go`: Config (:95-101) gains Budgets. New (:188-192) writes cfg.Budgets per field when set, else the registry value (registry.Budgets: zero means unset, `internal/registry/registry.go:28-32`).
- `internal/daemon/runs_test.go`: new tests beside TestRunPlanUsesFirstClaudeAndResolvedPermissions (:115) and TestChangedConfirmationPlanCannotStart (:287).
- `internal/engine/engine_test.go`: the budgets test for New.
- `docs/design.md`: Wave lifecycle step 2 (:147-150), Budgets (:529-533), and the proposed wire fields (:595-600).
- `docs/state.md`: the run.json lineup and budgets (:89-100) are the launch values; say so.
- Reference only, no change: `internal/daemon/runner.go` (:22-23) refuses any vendor but claude; `internal/engine/states.go` (:248) the gate resumes the reviewer's session; `internal/registry/registry.go` (:28-32).

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- TestRunPlanAppliesLineupOverride: a plan with an implementer override returns that entry for the implementer and the matrix row for the reviewer and gate.
- TestRunPlanGateFollowsReviewerOverride: a reviewer override also sets the gate, since the gate resumes the reviewer's session (states.go:248; design.md:580 "The gate uses the reviewer's lineup"). A gate key in the override is bad_params.
- TestRunPlanRefusesBadOverride: an unknown role, an empty model, or a vendor the daemon cannot run is bad_params, with no slicer write and no run created. Today only claude runs (runner.go:22-23); codex comes with S47.
- TestRunStartRecordsOverridesInRunJSON: the run record's lineup and budgets equal the override.
- TestRunStartExpectedCoversOverrides: run.start with an Expected plan built from a different override fails with "plan changed".
- TestNewBudgetsOverrideFallsBackPerField: Config.Budgets with minutes only keeps the registry tokens.
- TestRunPlanWithoutOverrideIsUnchanged: the existing TestRunPlanUsesFirstClaudeAndResolvedPermissions (:115) and TestChangedConfirmationPlanCannotStart (:287) still pass.
- TestRunOverrideWritesNoMatrix: the fake slicer sees no relay-roles write (record 133, `lineup.override-scope`, decided 2026-10-20: run only).

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the tests first (the Failing-tests above) with the existing fake slicer and runner in runs_test.go. Run them and confirm they fail.
2. runs.go: add `Lineup map[string][]runrec.LineupEntry` (json lineup, omitempty) and `Budgets *registry.Budgets` (json budgets, omitempty) to RunParams. Field names are proposed until `run.launch-wire` is decided.
3. planRun: after the recommend loop, for each role in the override, check it (implementer or reviewer only; vendor runnable; model and effort not empty) and replace the plan's entry. Copy the reviewer's entry to the gate. Return bad_params (badParams) on a failed check.
4. RunPlan: add Budgets, filled from the override or the registry, so the plan shows the values that will run.
5. engine.go: add Budgets to Config; New uses it per field over cfg.Project.Budgets.
6. startRun: pass plan.Budgets into engine.Config.
7. Update docs/design.md (:147-150, :529-533, :595-600) and docs/state.md (:89-100), citing records 132 to 134 (decided 2026-10-20).

Decided 2026-10-20: (a) record 132 (`lineup.launch-edit`): free vendor, model and effort per role, seeded from the matrix row; the daemon refuses a vendor it has no adapter for. (b) record 134 (`run.launch-wire`): the full chain per role plus budgets. (c) record 133 (`lineup.override-scope`): run only. Nothing is open.
Not in this slice: `ork run` flags for overrides; architect, split and slivers (S08, S61, S62); fallback across the chain (S49).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- go test -race -count=1 ./...
- go vet ./...
- gofmt -l .
- Run TestRunPlan*, TestRunStart*, TestNewBudgets* and TestRunOverride* by name with go test -run.
- slicer check
- adj lint
- [HUMAN CHECK] The owner reads the design.md and state.md changes.
